test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 13 March, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
In which of the following ways, aggregate demand function is related to consumption function?

I. They have the same slope C.

II. The aggregate demand function is parallel to the consumption function.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Both I and II**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The slope of the consumption function represents the marginal propensity to consume (MPC), which is the change in consumption resulting from a change in income.
 
• The aggregate demand function also includes consumption as a component, and therefore, the slope of the aggregate demand function is determined by the marginal propensity to consume. So, they have the same slope.
 
• The aggregate demand function consists of several components, including consumption, investment, government spending, and net exports.
 
• While the consumption function represents the relationship between consumption and income, the aggregate demand function represents the relationship between aggregate demand (total spending) and the overall price level.
 
• The aggregate demand function can be considered as the sum of all spending components, including consumption. Since consumption is a part of aggregate demand, the aggregate demand function and the consumption function are parallel to each other.

Therefore, both statements I and II are correct.
